mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly increase in GDP (GDPC1) over the past 3 months signals stronger demand, compressing discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in expanding demand periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.5% in 3 months triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as market anticipates weakening labor market conditions and reduced corporate growth.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in such periods are not significantly negative (t-test p < 0.05) or UNRATE stays below 4.5% for >6 months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in federal funds rates and rise in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) signals accommodative monetary policy and robust demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as market anticipates prolonged expansion.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in such interactions are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or the two proxies move inversely without a sustained trend.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising), higher discount rates reduce equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns in tightening periods are not significantly negative (t-test p < 0.05) or FEDFUNDS remains below 4.5% for >6 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in industrial production (INDPRO) below 110.0 in 3 months triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as market anticipates immediate supply easing constraints.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns in such periods are not significantly negative (t-test p < 0.05) or INDPRO recovers above 110.0 within 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals labor market strengthening, boosting corporate profits and equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns in improving labor markets are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or UNRATE rises above 4.0% for >6 months.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) and labor employment (PAYEMS) indicates robust economic expansion, lowering risk premiums and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as market anticipates sustained growth.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in such interactions are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or the proxies move inversely without a sustained trend.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 110.0 in a contraction phase signals weakening supply constraints, prompting market optimism and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate a rebound.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns in such periods are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or INDPRO recovers above 110.0 within 1 month.
